coefficient_units: Per-map logit addition = gamma_LAN*mean-log-LAN-map difference + gamma_titles*mean-log-Major-title difference + gamma_sub*(missing_B-missing_A).
roster_weight: Training map weight multiplies recency by roster_discount**(missing_A+missing_B); unknown actual lineups remain undiscounted and flagged unknown.
pressure_scope: Experience and pedigree scenario uplift applies throughout the simulated Major; historical validation applied it to known LAN series.
warning: Pressure scenario coefficients are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not validated estimates. Current chronological validation selects the result-only configuration. No claim of measured Major-specific causal advantage.
limitations: Model probabilities conditional on team form and greedy model-based veto; no explicit player substitution adjustment.
Latest official available standings snapshot is November 2. Match results refreshed through November 15.
Monte Carlo intervals quantify simulation noise only, not model or roster uncertainty.
Map outcomes treated as independent given ratings; team strength fixed throughout each simulated Major.
Current invited-team cohort defines historical data coverage; not a full-world historical backtest.
